title: Tow the Yard
summary: Start: enter Towline. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Tug Factor. Do: come within 480 meters of the Tug Factor. The tug matches your nose and holds the tow. The escort contract is a separate arrival. Finish: after the tug is met, come inside Tug Yard's shell. The Charter writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
